data.summary: Familienkasse Musterlahn grants Johanna Beispielacker Kinderzuschlag (supplementary child benefit) of €297 per month for each of her children Ida and Jonas, running from December 2026 to May 2027. The letter also states a right to file an objection (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The Familienkasse has approved an additional monthly payment (Kinderzuschlag) for your two children on top of any Kindergeld, based on your income and housing costs, for the period December 2026 through May 2027. You can also apply separately at your local municipality (Kommune) for education and participation benefits (Bildung und Teilhabe). If you think the decision is wrong (e.g. the amount or period), you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Familienkasse; the app shows the deadline. If you miss it, the decision becomes final. No action is required to receive the approved monthly payments themselves.
